1) Determine “local” members using the configured module scope (e.g., `__module__`/qualified name matching) and “imported” members using origin/qualified import source.  
2) Apply member-skip hooks (and any existing skip logic) to both sets consistently.  
3) Ensure template context receives the same keys/structure as before, only with corrected member lists.  
4) Add/adjust unit tests covering mixed local+imported modules and hook interactions.
